target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes
git add shadow_frontier
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Shadow Frontier: (D,eps) phase diagram, narrow-band exclusion write-up,
crossing statistics

- search/phase_diagram.py + viz/fig5_phase_diagram.png: the full
  (band-width, bias) phase diagram via Legendre-tilted strip transfer
  matrices. Boundary lambda_eff = 2 runs vertically at D* = 1.232 (band
  ratio 5.5) and saturates near eps* ~ 0.5 for wide bands. Pilot
  candidates sit in the allowed region (die by realizability, not
  counting).

  strip-count lemma (lambda(D) table, bracketed transfer-graph bound),
  dwell => cycle via repetition rigidity; (a) UNCONDITIONAL divergent-
  orbit exclusion: at most O(Y^theta(D)) consecutive steps in any band
  of ratio < 5.5; (b) full exclusion below ratio ~2.1 (theta < 1/(tau+1),
  Baker); (c) intermediate regime pins residual cycles' periods. Plus the
  complexity-free bounded-discrepancy corollary and the phase-diagram
  section routing counterexample bias into band crossings.
- search/crossing_stats.py: Target-2 pilot on 261 ascending stretches:
  strict ascent = exactly a b=1 run (the only ascending letter), so
  ascent IS 2-adic ghost-approach; identity max v2(x+1) >= maxrun+1
  verified at 1.000; speed/ghost-proximity correlation 0.476.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" -- shadow_frontier 2>&1 | tail -1
git push origin main 2>&1 | tail -1
cd shadow_frontier && ailog add --tool claude-code --level-hint 1 --text "PHASE DIAGRAM + NARROW-BAND WRITE-UP + CROSSING PILOT (pushed). (1) fig5_phase_diagram.png: lambda_eff(D,eps) via Legendre-tilted strip transfers (8 omega-directions, 15 tilts, 21 D-values); boundary vertical at D*=1.232 then saturating at eps* ~ 0.5; blue excluded region = all narrow bands + wide-band-high-bias; pilot candidates (D~3.4, eps~0.21) in allowed region as expected. COROLLARY: complexity-free bounded-discrepancy exclusion (subsumes Sturmian corollary for divergent orbits). (3) crossing_stats.py (261 stretches): STRUCTURAL INSIGHT - strict ascent <=> b=1 run (b=1 is the ONLY ascending letter) => every ascent is literally 2-adic ghost-approach; identity max v2(x_n+1) >= maxrun+1 verified P=1.000; corr(speed, ghost proximity)=0.476. NEXT: net-ascending (dip-tolerant) crossing windows; the run-budget lemma (total height gain = sum of run contributions, each charged 2-adically); interval-certified lambda(D)." 2>&1 | tail -1
